tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels on a low wooden dock and cups both palms together to scoop up water from a calm lake, lifting them toward its face as droplets fall.
tasks.camera: Medium close-up, slight low angle, palms turned upward toward camera
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands fully above the dock edge, palms open toward the lens, all ten fingers separated and unoccluded
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在码头用双手捧水，手掌朝上清晰可见。

tasks.instruction: Seated cross-legged on a cushion, the blue tiger presses both palms flat against an open book on its lap to smooth the pages, fingers spread wide across the paper.
tasks.camera: Overhead medium shot looking down at lap and book
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms lie flat on the book facing upward, all fingers splayed and clear of the pages' shadows
tasks.intent_zh: 盘坐读书，双手平摊按在书页上。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans over a balcony rail and raises both open palms to catch falling autumn leaves, tilting its head back with a delighted expression as leaves drift down.
tasks.camera: Low angle looking up past the tiger toward the sky
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms face the sky directly toward camera, fingers extended, no leaves obscuring the palms
tasks.intent_zh: 倚栏仰头，双手张开接住落叶。

tasks.instruction: Crouched beside a garden bed, the blue tiger holds both palms cupped around a small seedling, gently patting soil with its fingertips while looking down attentively.
tasks.camera: Close three-quarter view from slightly above the hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible from above, palms angled toward camera with fingertips and yellow pads clearly discernible
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在花圃旁，双手捧着幼苗培土。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a kitchen counter and claps both palms together in a firm press, elbows out, smiling at someone off-screen while flour puffs up around its hands.
tasks.camera: Eye-level medium shot, hands centered
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms pressed together facing camera edge-on, but all fingers of both hands clearly countable above and below the contact line
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在厨房台面上双手合掌拍打，面粉扬起。

tasks.instruction: Lying on its back on a picnic blanket, the blue tiger holds both palms up above its chest, fingers wiggling, watching a ladybug crawl across one palm toward the other.
tasks.camera: Directly overhead shot of the tiger on the blanket
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms face the overhead camera fully open, ladybug small enough not to hide any finger
tasks.intent_zh: 仰躺野餐垫上，双手举起让瓢虫爬过掌心。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches at a beach and presses both palms into wet sand, fingers spread, leaving clear handprints while glancing up at the camera over one shoulder.
tasks.camera: High angle looking down at the hands and sand
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat on sand facing down but visible from above, every finger and pad outline unshadowed
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在沙滩双手按沙留掌印，回头看向镜头。

tasks.instruction: Standing at a chalkboard, the blue tiger wipes the board with one open palm while the other palm rests flat against its hip, body angled toward the viewer.
tasks.camera: Medium full shot, three-quarter angle
tasks.visibility_requirement: Wiping palm faces the board but turned enough to camera; hip palm flat and fully visible, all fingers distinct
tasks.intent_zh: 站在黑板前一手擦板一手叉腰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a low stool tuning a guitar, pressing all fingertips of one hand along the fretboard while the other palm cups the guitar's neck, looking down in concentration.
tasks.camera: Medium close-up from the side, hands in sharp focus
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands clear of each other and the guitar body, fingers on fretboard and cupping palm both countable
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在凳上调吉他，一手按弦一手握琴颈。

tasks.instruction: Kneeling on a yoga mat, the blue tiger presses both palms together at its chest in a prayer pose, eyes closed, tail curled around its knees.
tasks.camera: Front medium shot, slightly low angle
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palms pressed together facing camera, fingertips pointing up, all fingers of both hands separately visible along the seam
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在瑜伽垫上双手合十于胸前。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reaches both palms toward a steaming mug on a table, fingers curled loosely around the air as if warming them, leaning forward with a relaxed smile.
tasks.camera: Medium close-up across the table
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms face the camera and mug, fingers spread and unobstructed by steam or mug
tasks.intent_zh: 伸手在杯子上方烘手，双掌朝向镜头。

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a windowsill, the blue tiger rests both palms flat on the ledge beside its thighs, leaning back against the frame and watching rain streak the glass.
tasks.camera: Wide medium shot from inside the room, slight side angle
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat on the sill, fingers pointing toward camera and fully separated, no rain distortion over hands
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在窗台，双手平放窗沿看雨。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches in a library aisle and slides both palms under a heavy stack of books, lifting them to its chest with fingers spread beneath the spines.
tasks.camera: Low medium shot from the aisle floor
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms visible beneath the book stack, yellow pads facing down toward camera, all fingers countable
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在书架间双手托起一摞书。

tasks.instruction: Perched on a boulder, the blue tiger holds both palms out flat and level as a small bird lands on one, the other palm open beside it in welcome.
tasks.camera: Side medium close-up, hands at chest height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms open upward toward camera, bird small and perched on fingertips without hiding the palm pads
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在巨石上摊开双掌让小鸟落脚。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a kitchen floor kneading bread dough, pressing both palms down and forward into the dough, flour dusting its fingers.
tasks.camera: High three-quarter angle looking down at the counter
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms pressed into dough but visible from above, flour not covering the finger separation
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在地上双手按压揉面团。

tasks.instruction: Reclining on a hammock, the blue tiger folds both palms behind its head, elbows wide, eyes half-closed in a lazy afternoon doze.
tasks.camera: Front medium shot slightly from below the hammock
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands behind the head but palms turned outward enough to show all fingers clear of the head fur
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在吊床上双手枕在脑后小憩。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels at a low table and presses both palms onto a sheet of clay, spreading its fingers to flatten the slab evenly.
tasks.camera: Overhead shot directly above the clay sheet
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat on clay facing up toward the overhead camera, all ten fingers spread and unobscured
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在矮桌前双手按压陶土板。

tasks.instruction: Standing beneath a tree, the blue tiger holds both palms up together to receive a heavy falling apple, bracing its stance with feet apart.
tasks.camera: Low angle from below the hands and branches
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms cupped upward toward camera, apple landing in the gap without covering fingers or pads
tasks.intent_zh: 站在树下双手合拢接住落下的苹果。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a swing and grips both chains with open palms wrapped loosely, thumbs inward, legs dangling and swaying gently.
tasks.camera: Front medium shot at swing height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands wrapped around chains but turned so palms and all fingers face the camera, chains thin enough not to hide digits
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在秋千上双手松松握住铁链。

tasks.instruction: Leaning over a map spread on a table, the blue tiger points with one flat palm at a route while the other palm holds the map corner flat.
tasks.camera: High three-quarter view over the shoulder onto the map
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat over the map facing up toward camera, pointing fingers extended and corner-holding fingers separated
tasks.intent_zh: 俯身桌上地图，一手平指路线一手按住边角。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lowers itself into a warm bath, gripping both edges of the tub with spread palms, steam rising around its shoulders as it sighs contentedly.
tasks.camera: Medium front shot at tub rim height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat on the tub rim facing camera, fingers spread wide and steam not covering the pads
tasks.intent_zh: 坐进浴缸双手撑住边缘，蒸汽升腾。

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a park bench, the blue tiger cups both palms around a paper bag of popcorn, offering it forward toward the viewer with an inviting grin.
tasks.camera: Eye-level medium close-up, bag centered between palms
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms visible on either side of the bag facing up and outward, all fingers clear of the paper fold
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在长椅上双手捧爆米花递向镜头。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches at a stream and splashes water toward the camera with both open palms, laughing as droplets scatter from its fingertips.
tasks.camera: Front low angle, hands thrust toward lens
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms face camera fully open mid-splash, fingers splayed, water droplets sparse enough to keep pads visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在溪边双手向镜头泼水，笑着。

tasks.instruction: Sitting at a piano bench, the blue tiger rests both palms flat on the keys in a final chord, looking up toward the viewer with a satisfied expression.
tasks.camera: Three-quarter overhead shot of hands on keys
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat on white keys facing camera, each finger resting on a separate key and clearly countable
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在钢琴凳上双手按最后一和弦，抬头看镜头。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its stomach on a rug, propped on elbows, holding a phone in both palms and tapping the screen with a thumb while its chin rests on one palm.
tasks.camera: Close three-quarter front view at rug level
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands cradle the phone facing camera, palm of the chin-resting hand turned outward with fingers spread
tasks.intent_zh: 趴在地毯上双手拿手机，一手托腮。

tasks.instruction: Standing over a bowl of fruit, the blue tiger presses both palms down onto a lemon and orange to test ripeness, fingers curving around each fruit.
tasks.camera: High close-up looking down into the bowl
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms drape over the fruit facing the overhead camera, fingers of each hand separated and visible around the curves
tasks.intent_zh: 站立双手按柠檬和橙子试成熟度。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a floor cushion and presses both palms onto its own knees, leaning forward to stretch its back, palms flat and fingers pointing down.
tasks.camera: Side medium shot, hands and knees in frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat on knees facing outward to camera, all fingers extended and unobscured by clothing folds
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在垫子上双手按膝前倾拉伸背部。

tasks.instruction: Crouched on a snowy path, the blue tiger presses both palms into fresh snow to make a pair of prints, looking up cheerfully as flakes settle on its ears.
tasks.camera: High angle down onto the snow and hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms sunk in snow but visible from above, finger wells clear and pads pressed against the surface
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在雪地双手按出掌印，抬头微笑。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits at a potter's wheel, wrapping both palms around a spinning clay vessel, thumbs pressing the rim as it shapes the opening.
tasks.camera: Medium close-up from the side, wheel and hands centered
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms on opposite sides of the vessel angled toward camera, all fingers and yellow pads visible against wet clay
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在陶轮前双手环抱塑造陶罐口沿。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels on a bed and fluffs a pillow with both palms, pressing and releasing the fabric, then turning toward the camera with a sleepy smile.
tasks.camera: Low front medium shot at mattress level
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms pressed on the pillow facing camera, fingers spread over the pillow corners and not buried in fabric
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在床上双手拍松枕头。
